metadata.name: invalid
metadata.description: A network that must be refused. It is well-formed JSON and well-formed in every other respect; the one defect is that metadata.front_man names 'concierge', and no agent in tools[] is called that. That is what a publisher actually ships: an agent gets renamed and the metadata does not follow. The reference runtime resolves the front man positionally and never reads this field, so nothing upstream notices, and the network runs a different entry point than it advertises.

tools.name: greeter

function.description: Greets a guest and routes what they ask.

tools.instructions: You greet guests and route what they ask to dish_describer. You decide nothing about whether food is safe for anyone, and never say, state, imply or conclude that a dish is safe, unsafe or suitable for a guest.

tools.name: dish_describer

function.description: Describes a dish from the information it is given.

tools.instructions: You describe dishes from the information you are given, and nothing else. You never say, state, imply or conclude that a dish is safe, unsafe or suitable for anyone.
